sections.heading: Thrissur: Kerala's Ayurvedic Medicine Manufacturing Centre
paragraphs: No other Indian city concentrates Ayurvedic manufacturing the way Thrissur does. Oushadhi, formally The Pharmaceutical Corporation (Indian Medicines) Kerala Ltd, began in 1941 as the Sree Kerala Varma Government Ayurvedic Pharmacy, was registered under its present name in 1975, and is owned by the Government of Kerala. Its factory, R&D centre and head office are at Kuttanellur in Thrissur city, it describes itself as the largest public-sector producer of Ayurvedic medicines in India, holds GMP and ISO 9001:2015 certification, has a packing section built to WHO GMP standard, and in 2018 opened a unit for proprietary medicines at Muttathara.

Vaidyaratnam Oushadhasala, founded by Ashtavaidyan E. T. Neelakandhan Mooss, has its mother plant at Thaikkattussery near Ollur in Thrissur, upgraded to a GMP-certified unit with ISO accreditation in 2003, with a second Thrissur plant at Chuvannamannu beside the Peechi forest and a third at Pollachi in Tamil Nadu from 2009. Around them, the Thrissur Ayurveda Cluster at the KINFRA Industrial Park, Koratty, was approved by the Ministry of AYUSH in 2005 and is run by a consortium of 62 Ayurvedic manufacturers with support from KINFRA and KSIDC, providing common testing, analysis, product validation and safety-study facilities; KINFRA gives the Koratty park as 30 acres with 35 units.

sections.heading: What an Ayurvedic Plant in Thrissur Pipes, and Why the Bore Finish Matters
paragraphs: Classical Ayurvedic manufacture is wet, hot and sticky. Kashayams are decoctions boiled down from herbs for hours; arishtams and asavams are fermented in large vessels; thailams are medicated oils cooked with herb pastes; lehyams and ghritams are thick pastes and medicated ghee. Each is transferred, filtered, concentrated and filled through pipework, and each leaves a residue of plant solids, sugars, oils and colour that dries hard in a rough bore and carries flavour and organisms into the next batch.

That is why the modern units at Kuttanellur, Thaikkattussery and Koratty specify hygienic stainless rather than the open vessels of the past. An electropolished SF4 316L bore, to ASME BPE surface designations, has a lower Ra and a chromium-rich passive surface, so decoction concentrate, fermentation liquor and medicated oil release to the CIP cycle instead of clinging, and the fermentation vessels and their transfer lines can be held free of wild organisms between batches. On lines carrying plain water, steam condensate or utilities, SF1 mechanically polished 304L is sufficient.

sections.heading: Grade Selection for Decoction, Fermentation and Oil Lines in Thrissur
paragraphs: Decoctions and fermented preparations are mildly acidic and are processed hot, and acid and chlorinated cleaning follows them, so 316L is the grade for product-contact lines; 304L pits where sanitiser stands in a warm line. Medicated oils and ghee are not corrosive, but they set in cool pipe, so the case for an electropolished bore there is cleaning and changeover rather than corrosion. Where an extraction unit uses strong acids or chloride-bearing solvents, ask us to quote 904L, which we supply electropolished.

Ayurvedic plants exporting under AYUSH GMP and ISO systems increasingly document their product-contact surfaces the way a pharmaceutical plant does, and the Koratty cluster's testing and validation facilities exist for that reason. Every heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory, every length is PMI tested, and each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report. Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015, and we supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L.

sections.heading: Sending a Thrissur RFQ
paragraphs: Send a complete enquiry and the quotation comes back within 24 hours. For Ayurvedic, food or other process units in Thrissur district, including Kuttanellur, Ollur and the KINFRA park at Koratty, please tell us:
bullets: The preparation and line: decoction or concentrate, fermentation and transfer, medicated oil or ghee, paste, filling, CIP, or utilities, and whether you are the manufacturer, a machinery builder or an installation contractor.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for product contact, fermentation and CIP return; SF1 304L or 316L for water, steam condensate and utilities; 904L electropolished for acid or chloride service.
Tube OD, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A270, A269, A249 or A312, and the clamp or SMS fittings they join to.
GMP or export-audit documentation required, and the delivery address in Thrissur district.
